name: CDN Cache Purge API
description:
Purge cached dataset query results or one dataset image or file from Sanity's CDN.

Self-service cache purging must be enabled for the project. Authenticate with a user or robot token that has permission to update project datasets. The Administrator and Developer roles include this permission.

See [Purge CDN caches](https://www.sanity.io/docs/content-lake/purge-cdn-caches) for usage, completion guarantees, and rate limits.
